Scene = SimToolReal's MuJoCo sim2sim scene (github.com/tylerlum/simtoolreal, MIT, deployment/mujoco/mujoco_sim.py),
rebuilt here without its training stack: KUKA iiwa 14 (MuJoCo Menagerie) + left Sharpa HA4 hand attached at the iiwa
flange, a 0.475 x 0.4 x 0.3 m table (top at z = 0.53 m), the tool (convex-decomposed meshes) and a green goal marker
(no contacts). Physics 600 Hz (implicitfast, elliptic cones, multi-CCD, gravity-compensated robot), control 60 Hz.

the current goal counts as reached when all 8 keypoints of the tool's grasp box (0.141 x 0.03025 x 0.0271 m, scaled

10 s (600 control steps); a goal not reached in time ends the attempt. progress = goals reached / number of goals.

import numpy as np
import mujoco
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
import rcb_dtb

np.set_printoptions(precision=4,suppress=True)
s=rcb_dtb.Session('/app/instance.json')
m=s.model
kin=mujoco.MjData(m)
palm=m.body('palmworld').id
q0=s.state()['q'].copy()
init_pos=s.data.xpos[palm].copy();init_rot=R.from_matrix(s.data.xmat[palm].reshape(3,3)).as_rotvec()

def ik_palm(pos,rotvec=None,seed=None):
    if rotvec is None:rotvec=init_rot
    if seed is None:seed=s.state()['q'][:7]
    qbase=s.state()['q'].copy()
    def fun(q):
        kin.qpos[:]=s.data.qpos;kin.qpos[s._jq[:7]]=q
        mujoco.mj_forward(m,kin)
        p=kin.xpos[palm];rv=(R.from_rotvec(rotvec)*R.from_matrix(kin.xmat[palm].reshape(3,3)).inv()).as_rotvec()
        return np.r_[15*(p-pos),5*rv,.04*(q-seed)]
    sol=least_squares(fun,seed,bounds=(s.lower[:7]+.0001,s.upper[:7]-.0001),max_nfev=100,ftol=1e-7,xtol=1e-7)
    return sol.x, np.linalg.norm(sol.fun[:3])/15,sol.cost

def hand_pose(level):
    q=np.zeros(22)
    # order as in _F
    q[:5]=np.array([1.2,0,0.9,0,1.0])*level
    for start in (5,9,13):q[start:start+4]=np.array([1.0,0,1.2,.8])*level
    q[17:]=np.array([.16,.9,0,1.1,.8])*level
    return q

def log(label):
    st=s.state(); p=s.progress()
    cs=[]
    for j in range(s.data.ncon):
        c=s.data.contact[j];n1=m.geom(c.geom1).name;n2=m.geom(c.geom2).name
        if 'object_object' in n1 or 'object_object' in n2: cs.append((n1,n2,round(c.dist,3)))
    print(label,'step',s.steps,'obj',st['object_pos'],'quat',st['object_quat_wxyz'],'palm',st['palm_pos'],'dist',p['goal_distance_m'],'contacts',cs[:12],flush=True)

def moveto(q,steps=120):
    start=s.state()['q']
    for i in range(steps):s.step(start+(q-start)*(i+1)/steps)

if __name__=='__main__':
    t=time.time();s.record_start(); log('start')
    q,err,cost=ik_palm(init_pos+[0,-.027,-.105]); print('IK',q,err,cost,flush=True)
    target=q0.copy();target[:7]=q
    moveto(target,180);log('lower')
    target[7:]=hand_pose(1)
    moveto(target,180);log('close')
    q,err,cost=ik_palm(init_pos+[0,-.027,-.005],seed=target[:7]);print('lift IK',q,err,cost,flush=True)
    target[:7]=q
    moveto(target,180);log('lift')
    A=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(A,path='/app/output/probe.npz')
    print('elapsed',time.time()-t,flush=True)
